name: fazen-memory
description: Keeps long Claude Code chats on track: a code word that proves the rules are still followed, checkpoints, an automatic handoff to a fresh chat when the context gets too long, and automatic yes to obvious continuation questions.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of Fazen Memory's messages and default code word. auto = Claude Code's language setting, otherwise your system language.

codeword.title: Default code word
codeword.description: Phrase that opens every reply when Fazen Memory is on. Empty = "Yes Brother!" in English, "Si Fratello!" in Italian.
